name: repo-assist-verify
description: Shim so npm-based verification runs this Rust project's real gates.

scripts.test: export RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN:-1.99.1-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu}; mkdir -p /tmp/ra-test && TMPDIR=/tmp/ra-test cargo fmt --all --check && TMPDIR=/tmp/ra-test cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && TMPDIR=/tmp/ra-test cargo test --all-targets
